mapper.sql: o.application_id, o.memo, o.version, o.updated_at, u.display_name AS updated_by_display_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM application_operations o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.updated_by WHERE o.space_id = #{spaceId} AND o.event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_operations ( application_id, space_id, event_id, memo, version, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{memo}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (application_id) DO NOTHING
